title: Design System: Melhor Saída para o Brasil

display.purpose: Hero headlines only: cream condensed type on dawn, max 14ch.

headline.purpose: Section titles in Barlow Condensed, max 16ch.

body.purpose: Reading copy in Overpass; section measure 68ch.

label.purpose: Uppercase condensed destination rows and board grammar.

shadows.name: cover-lift
shadows.purpose: Ebook cover only; not a general offset language.

shadows.name: headline-dusk
shadows.purpose: Display text-shadow on the dawn photograph.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Board row hover and split-flap verb.

motion.name: row-hover
motion.purpose: Background transition on live board rows.

motion.name: flap
motion.purpose: Split-flap cycle on a single inline verb; disabled when prefers-reduced-motion.

breakpoints.name: stack
breakpoints.purpose: Band, split, product, and board collapse to one column; board headers hide.

components.name: Primary Buy
components.description: Yellow route slab for conversion and in-page hops.
components.css: .ds-buy { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 3rem; padding: 0 1.2rem; background: var(--band, #f5c400); color: var(--band-ink, #111111); font-family: "Overpass Variable", Overpass, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 750; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 0; box-shadow: 0 10px 18px rgb(20 17 12 / 0.16); } .ds-buy:hover { background: var(--ink, #14110c); color: var(--band, #f5c400); } .ds-buy:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #111111); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-buy[aria-disabled="true"] { opacity: 0.55; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Cell in the yellow decision band.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 1.15rem; min-height: 4.25rem; background: var(--band, #f5c400); color: var(--band-ink, #111111); font-family: "Overpass Variable", Overpass, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 650; text-decoration: none; border: 0; border-left: 2px solid var(--band-ink, #111111); border-radius: 0; } .ds-nav-link:hover { background: rgb(17 17 17 / 0.08); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #111111); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Nav CTA
components.description: Inverted band cell that routes to the guides.
components.css: .ds-nav-cta { display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 1.15rem; min-height: 4.25rem; background: var(--band-ink, #111111); color: var(--band, #f5c400); font-family: "Overpass Variable", Overpass, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 650; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 0; } .ds-nav-cta:hover { background: var(--open, #9b1c2e); color: var(--paper, #f4ead6); } .ds-nav-cta:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #111111); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Board Row
components.description: Live destination row on the metal board.
components.css: .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.4fr 0.7fr 0.9fr; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.85rem 1.1rem; background: var(--metal-dark, #2a261f); color: var(--paper, #f4ead6); font-family: "Barlow Condensed", sans-serif; font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 3vw, 2.1rem); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(196 184 150 / 0.12); border-radius: 0; transition: background 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-row:hover { background: rgb(245 196 0 / 0.12); } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #111111); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-status { justify-self: end; }

components.name: Board Row Open
components.description: The only yellow row: the open life-route.
components.css: .ds-row-open { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.4fr 0.7fr 0.9fr; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.85rem 1.1rem; background: var(--band, #f5c400); color: var(--band-ink, #111111); font-family: "Barlow Condensed", sans-serif; font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 3vw, 2.1rem); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 0; } .ds-row-open .ds-status { justify-self: end; color: var(--open, #9b1c2e); } .ds-row-open:hover { background: var(--band, #f5c400); } .ds-row-open:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #111111); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Board Row Waiting
components.description: Closed lives: metal type, not a link.
components.css: .ds-row-wait { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.4fr 0.7fr 0.9fr; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.85rem 1.1rem; background: var(--metal-dark, #2a261f); color: var(--metal, #c4b896); font-family: "Barlow Condensed", sans-serif; font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 3vw, 2.1rem); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; border-radius: 0; } .ds-row-wait .ds-status { justify-self: end; }

components.name: Hope Panel
components.description: Translucent paper field over dawn for reading.
components.html:
A melhor saída não é fugir.

Recomeçar é possível, com material que cabe na mesa.
components.css: .ds-hope { background: rgb(244 234 214 / 0.92); color: var(--ink, #14110c); padding: 12vh 5vw; border-radius: 0; } .ds-hope-title { margin: 0 0 0.75rem; max-width: 16ch; font-family: "Barlow Condensed", sans-serif; font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 6vw, 4.4rem); font-weight: 700; line-height: 0.95; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-hope-body { margin: 0; max-width: 68ch; font-family: "Overpass Variable", Overpass, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.0625rem; line-height: 1.55; }

components.name: Site Footer
components.description: Ink field with paper name and metal disclaimer.
components.html:
Melhor Saída para o Brasil

Conteúdo informativo. Não é assessoria jurídica.
components.css: .ds-footer { display: grid; gap: 1rem; padding: 3rem 5vw 4rem; background: var(--ink, #14110c); color: var(--paper, #f4ead6); border-radius: 0; font-family: "Overpass Variable", Overpass, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-footer p { margin: 0; } .ds-footer small { max-width: 68ch; color: var(--metal, #c4b896); }

narrative.overview:
This world is a restart route, not a travel brochure. A saturated yellow decision band sticks to the top of every page like terminal wayfinding; under it, a cream condensed headline sits on a dawn sky, then a dark metal destination board lists possible lives. The airport is a wink in the name and in the board’s grammar (columns, statuses, split-flap motion on one verb). It is never the subject: no jets, no gates, no luggage iconography.

Surfaces are square, type is black-on-yellow or cream-on-dawn, and conversion is a yellow slab button — the same yellow as the band, inverted to ink on hover. Products are ruled listings with a cover, not a grid of equal cards. Paraguay is the only open row; other lives wait in metal type.
keyCharacteristics: Sticky yellow wayfinding band with condensed uppercase identity
Monumental cream condensed headlines on photographic dawn ground
Dark metal destination board as the destination index
Wine reserved for “open route” heat (status and the nav CTA hover)

rules.name: The One Open Heat Rule
rules.body: Wine is heat for an open route (board status and nav CTA hover). It never fills a hero, a section, or a product card.

rules.name: The Yellow Is The Route Rule
rules.body: Saturated yellow is the decision layer: band, open row, buy. It is not a decorative accent stripe on a white travel page.

rules.name: The Condensed Board Rule
rules.body: Destination names, statuses, brand, and monumental headlines live in Barlow Condensed. Overpass never headlines a destination.

rules.name: The No Airport Display Face Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce a system display serif, a seven-segment numeral face, or a novelty “departures” font. The board is type + metal, not a gadget skin.

rules.name: The Ground Then Board Rule
rules.body: The photograph is the sky. UI does not recede into frost or cards floating on white. Yellow and metal sit on the dawn.

dos: Do keep the sticky yellow band as chrome on every page, with condensed uppercase identity.
Do set display headlines in cream condensed type on the dawn ground, tight leading (0.86).
Do index destinations on the metal board; only the open route gets the yellow row and wine status.
Do sell with yellow buy slabs and ruled listings, not a grid of equal product cards.
Do keep corners at 0 and type in Overpass + Barlow Condensed.
donts: Don't build a travel hero (jet, runway, suitcase, passport collage) or make the airport the subject.
Don't give closed destinations the same visual weight as the open row.
Don't use wine as a section fill or a second yellow.
Don't round the band, board, or buy, or introduce a serif display face.
Don't turn listings into equal-height product cards.
